biotools.summary: sxLaep is a resource-efficient framework designed for high-throughput enzyme pre-screening from large-scale metagenomic sequences. It uses lightweight physicochemical features to rapidly predict enzymatic sequences, filtering datasets before resource-intensive annotation.
